notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.4.2 - Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, here's version 1.4.2, a small bug-fix update:

Fixes:
- Completing the game in 1CC on Manic difficulty now also unlocks achievements for lower difficulty modes (Hard/Normal).
- Completing the game in 1CC on Hard difficulty now also unlocks achievements for lower difficulty modes (Normal).
- Defeating the game with the "Ultimate Boss" now correctly adds it to the Bestiary and unlocks the Bestiary completion achievement.
- Fixed a crash occurring on one of Lee's choices (when the choices have been unlocked).
- Restarting from the Training Mode menu now correctly resets the player's remaining lives.
- The texts in the unlocked scenes are now correctly aligned.

New Feature:
- The "Pause On Hit" option selected from the Extra Menu is now saved for future play sessions.

notes.title: Version 1.4.0: Minor adjustments
notes.notes:
Hello, Here’s what’s new in version 1.4.0:

 - Scores displayed at the end of stages:
The scores of eliminated players are now shown on the Stage Clear screen 
(unless a replacement/Pilot change has occurred in the meantime).

 - Collision improvements:
Fixed an issue where certain grounded enemies incorrectly collided with players. These collisions have now been disabled, ensuring smoother and more intuitive gameplay.

 - Camera speed adjustments:
The camera's movement has been slightly optimized for a better experience.

Thank you for your support !

notes.title: Update 1.3.0: Master the Training Mode and Unleash Your Full Potential!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that update 1.3.0 is now live! You can now dive into the all-new Training Mode.

Training Mode in "I Got Isekai'd into a Shmup":
Select any of the 8 stages and sharpen your skills.

You can restart the level at any point during your training session to perfect your performance. Track down all the silver stars, and get ready to unleash your best run in Story Mode or Arcade Mode!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 : Portuguese and Japanese support!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that update 1.2.0 is now available! 
You can now enjoy the game in Portuguese and Japanese!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Arcade Option And PS Controller support
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We’ve just released a new update for our game!

This update introduces an exciting new Arcade Mode that lets you jump straight into the action—no dialogue, no comic-style introduction, just pure gameplay.

We’ve also added complete support for PS4 and PS5 controllers. While they were already compatible, the on-screen buttons will now match the controller layout, making for a smoother experience.

Additionally, we've fixed a few minor text issues within the game.

We hope you enjoy these new features! 
Thank you for your continued support, and happy gaming!

Best regards,
TOMAGameStudio Dev Team
